report_summary:
Audit Date & Time: 6 Nov 2021, 7.48PM
Audit Location: Vision Express, Seasons Mall Magarpatta, Pune
The Store is located inside the mall on the first floor and was easily accessible through the escalator and elevator. The signboard is backlit and was visible from afar –The signboard is also visible from the ground floor.   
We walked into the store there were around 3 customers present in the store during the time of visit. There were 5 staff members present out of which two female staff members were wearing a doctor coat supposedly  Optometrist and the remaining 3 looked like sales executives – dressed in Red T-shirts with company branding.
All the staff members were wearing their ID cards and masks. All of the staff were well-groomed. 
The sales representative who approached me directly started of asking what I was looking for and directed me towards the frames and quoted the price range that was available for all the frames. 
He mentioned that the frames are segregated price-wise and asked me to choose the desired frame and also mentioned that there is a buy one get once free offer by paying 399 extra.
When asked for zero lenses he showed a few frames that are coated and are ready to use if not the frame will have to be selected and the lenses can be fixed within 3-4 days.  
 On questioning the offer – he mentioned buy 1 get 1 and 50% off on buying a single frame. 
Any frames above INR 2499 will have a better quality and durability. 
I kept choosing the frames and customers kept walking in and the salesperson was by my side – he then suggested I go for an eye test when I complained about a slight headache  
He then introduced me to a Sr Optometrist named Sakshi. Sakshi was very professional and she was very polite during the test – greeted Hi, how are you and took down my name, age, address, and contact number – She questioned about my profession and tried to build a good rapport with me by empathizing and questions if I am experiencing any issue with my eyesight and was enquiring about the pain and where do I experience the pain. Medical history, current medication. She called out that she will first be performing the computerized testing and then will conduct a manual test. She at all points tried to ensure if I was feeling comfortable. She completed the test and made notes of the findings. She then conducted the manual test and conducted all the tests for both eyes. Upon questioning the reason for the headache she helped me understand that it is due to strain – She also made me understand the 20 20 20 rule – and blinking pattern and it will give me more relief. 
I then walked out of the testing room the Optometrist handed the prescription to the salesperson. The salesperson then explained which lenses are better for me as per the prescription. He explained the offers 
 


The 50% discount offer will be valid on frames and lens without power. If I go for a lens with a power discount on the lens will be 20% and 50% on the frame can be availed.  There is also an offer for buy 1 get 1. 
The salesperson was very polite and offered us water and a chair to sit in. He was also knowledgeable and was answering our queries with ease. 

The overall score for Seasons Mall store: 8/10

report_summary:
Audit Date & Time: 31 OCT 2021, 6:00PM
Audit Location: Vision Express, NIBM Kondhwa, Pune
The Store is located in a complex on the main road and was easy to find. The signboard was visible from afar and was backlit making it visible in the dark as well. The view of the store is not obstructed by the moving traffic as it is situated at a higher level (easily accessible by stairs) than the main road. 
The inside of the store was also well lit too. The store at the time of visit did not have any customers, the salesperson was seated in a chair who walked up to me as soon as I walked into the store and wished me good evening, and asked me what was I looking for. The salesperson was well-groomed and was wearing a t-shirt with company branding. He was not wearing any ID card eager to assist and was showing me the whole range of available frames in the store. He was answering all my questions and was assisting me to check out and try almost every frame available on display. He mentioned that there is an ongoing offer where customers can avail themselves of a discount of 50% on the frame and lens. Upon requesting to try a different type of frame the salesperson picked it up from the display and made me try it. Upon raising objection on the size and fit, he showed more options that were fitting better. He repeatedly made it a point that there is a 50% discount that can be availed both on the frame and the lens. 
Further questioning the lens type – he explained that the lens will be a fiber lens with UV protection and scratch-resistant – When mentioned – there is discomfort and usually there is a headache and pain behind the eyes the salesperson suggested to go for a test and that the test was available in the store. The Optometrist at that point was outside the store and the salesperson attending me asked the second salesperson to call the Optometrist for the test who came after about 5-6 minutes(17.02).  
The 50% discount offer will be valid on frames and lens without power. If I go for a lens with a power discount on the lens will be 20% and 50% on the frame can be availed. 
Upon questioning if the additional features like anti-fog, ant scratch can also be added to the deal and get a discount on these additional features. The salesperson did not have an answer to that and mentioned he will check and get back. 
The salesperson was able to explain the difference between all the plans available gold, silver bronze. 
The Optometrist then came in and was taken for the test. Upon questioning if a doctor will be required to complete the test – the salesperson mentioned that a doctor is not required. It would have been better if the salesperson would have called out that the person performing the test is a specialist an Optometrist that would have been reassuring for the customer. 
The optometrist did not introduce herself as a specialist. She asked basic questions like when did I last get a test done, History, and if lenses are being used currently. She started the test and gave instructions. However, did not mention what kind of test she is performing. Informing or walking the customer through the test being performed would be great for the customer’s understanding. She then completed the test and recommended to go for a good lens as there is an increase in the eyesight number she marked the prescription with her findings and handed it over to the salesperson Mohan. 
None of the salespersons or Optometrists introduced themselves with their names – their names were present on the name board in the testing area. 
Mohan then suggested to go with the best package – to which I questioned about the buy one get one offer and mentioned that my spouse also needs a pair and denied to make an immediate purchase. Mohan politely mentioned that the offer is valid for today if I return at a later date I will not be able to avail the offer and that I make the payment and return later to have the frame selection done to make the offer applicable on a later transaction. However, I denied making a purchase at that point The salesperson politely acknowledged the refusal. 
He then made a note of my name and number and escorted me to the exit thanking me for the visit. 
In the interim, I also requested to use the washroom which was not smelly but was a bit shabby could have been much cleaner as the drain was open and there was a brick placed in the washroom with no toilet paper.  The wash basis was clean and there was liquid soap available for handwash. 

The overall score for NIBM Kondhwa store: 7/10

report_summary: I had visited the Vision Express, Ansal Plaza Mall, Sector-23, Gurgaon on 3rd July'22 around 18:52 PM IST evening time. I was accompanied by my spouse and son during the visit and I inquired foe frames and lenses. I had observed 3 attended and 3~4 customers were presented at the time of visit. Where Mr. Tauseef was engaged to us through out the duration since start to last. When I entered into the store one of the staff greeted with 'Hello' and asked about the purpose of our visit. Then he suggested me the eye screening and asked us to wait for few mins and offered seat to us. Moreover, the available staff were found in expected uniforms and having company ID card. However, they carried company ID card in hide mode and no water bottle was offered to us.At the time of interaction Mr. Tauseef (Optometrists) listen all my queries proactively and answered all of them properly. The whole Interaction was pretty much smooth and informative. Optometrists Mr. Tauseef took my some basic details related to gadget uses, health related and then he recommended me to have an eye test first proactively. Inbetween I went through the different eye test procedures under the guidance of optometrists Mr. Tauseef. Where he noted down all the required information in his records and gave me eye number information alongwith the prescription card. However, he didn't perform the Slit lamp Examination/Torch Light Examination. The frame range was started at the Rs. 999/- and Mr. Tauseef suggested some good designed based frames to us. They also shared some zero power  blue-ray frames with a 50% discount for kids. The sales representative explained about blue-ray with some demo units. Also, he informed us about the harmless impact of blue-rays on our eyes. Moreover, explained that problem that protection lenses are made of good quality and light weight materials and they absorb around 80% of harmful Blue rays. Further, he explained the customization options like UV, photochromatic and son on with power lenses.Apart from that there was 20% discount was running on the lenses. Mr. Tauseef explained about the running flat 50% discount on the powerless lenses with blue ray enabled features. Also, explained about the BUY ONE and GET ONE scheme where any customer can get the blueray frame with the power lenses , I believe which a good deal at the store side. The billing process was quite smooth and done within approx.. 10 mins of time. The final closing with the respective sales executive was quite good and pleasant where they 'Thanked us' in a polite manner and offered to revisit the store. However, he didn't drop us near the exit gate.He suggested some services tips with uses, where I had to take break of 5~10 mins after every 2 hours during initial period of transition i.e . of 5~7 days. Afterwards, he confirmed me that I will not face any major challenges hopefully further. However, he didn't about warranty policy and no information call related to spectacle readiness.The store cleanliness, signage, standee were upto the mark. However, less light was observed in the eye test room. Other than this no other such major discrepancy was observed at the time of audit. Overall, we had a good experience at the store. The staff was quite good at their jobs and good representatives of the brand. They offered eye test proactively and engaged us in a nice way, explaining the products and services they offer. I will surely recommend the store to my family and friends based on the above shared observations.

report_summary:
I visited the store on 24/01/2023. I would expect a brand like GIVA to be more visible than hidden in the corner where this counter was (unfortunately doesn't look like a store). Minimal decorations were done as it is very soon Valentine's Day. I was greeted a bit late, as the staff was busy connecting to someone from the Nexus Mall who was checking on the setup, issues, lighting, etc. The products displayed were minimal, and no backup products of the pieces displayed were available. I liked one of the Paris collections, unfortunately, no other piece was there. Also, the product had a production defect. Due to the minimal type of products and availability in quantity, the staff couldn't cross-sell nor suggest more options. She could suggest what was available, however, she suggested coming back on Sunday when more products will be available. Once I chose to buy, her other colleague mentioned the warranty, return policy, etc. When I asked for a freebie or discount she smiled and said already there is a 10% discount. But along with the product warranty and product care-related instructions, they gave me a discount voucher to use on my next purchase. Overall, the experience was pleasant but could have been better compared to the brand value GIVA has in the market. The counter/store could be more visible and slightly bigger and more prominent. It looked more like an advertisement counter than where a customer can buy from.

During the entire visit I wasn't promptly offered to sit anywhere which was disappointing as I had traveled far with a heavy backpack, but once she understood that I am going to buy a product was when the staff asked me to put my Heavy bag down and look at the product comfortably. The display lighting was not up to the mark, the products looked dull as the lighting focus was not right. All in all, would I recommend GIVA as a brand to my friends and family yes, but will I recommend this specific store maybe I wouldn't as it is just a waste of my time when not many products I can find in this store. When I asked for more options, I was asked to visit the other store in the same locality.

report_summary:
I conducted a visit to Peter England, located in Sarath City Mall, Kondapur, and overall, it was a good store experience. The store was easily locatable within the mall, thanks to helpful staff and clear signboards. The appearance of the store was pleasing, although there were a few minor issues that need attention.

Firstly, I was not particularly satisfied with the store manager and the salesperson who assisted me. The salesperson lacked enthusiasm and did not greet me or show much interest in assisting me unless prompted. On several occasions, while inquiring about offers or apparel, the salesperson remained seated at the cashier's desk, which felt awkward and disrespectful.

Additionally, there were some concerns regarding the trial room. The hangers were broken, which impacted the presentation of the garments. Moreover, the door lock was excessively hard to operate, causing inconvenience and even causing slight physical discomfort while opening and closing it.

Furthermore, I was surprised to find that there were no kids' apparel available in the store. I was informed that a separate store had to be visited for children's clothing. This lack of a dedicated section for kids' apparel seemed inconvenient and could be improved upon.

While the store experience was generally positive, a few enhancements could be made to elevate the overall shopping experience. For instance, the absence of background music and the lack of a pleasant perfume ambiance were unexpected. These subtle additions can significantly contribute to creating a more engaging and immersive shopping atmosphere.

In conclusion, my audit of the Peter England store at Sarath City Mall highlights a satisfactory experience overall, with a few areas that require attention. Improving customer engagement, addressing trial room issues, providing a children's apparel section, and enhancing the store's ambiance would contribute to making it an even better shopping destination.

This could be tiring for customers, finances are handled by one person, the car details are handled by another and the ultimate discount is given by another. I had a good test ride with the Evoque. It was a good ride to understand the technical side of the car's technical specs.

I would suggest that the employee could be trained and coached better to look at every customer as a potential customer and not judge them by how they look. Also, he should be showcasing basic manners of greeting someone when he meets someone for the first time. He never bothered to get up nor shake a hand or give clear details. Because not necessarily every person buys a luxury car always, there could be first-timers as well. It reflects a bad reputation in the showroom and as the ambassador of the brand, it tainted the brand reputation it has to date.

And unfortunately, I was not even shown the pricing list as a minimum courtesy for a customer. I nor anyone would expect this sort of behaviour from an elite brand showroom. And finally, for accessories, I was asked to visit the Land Rover website post where they would discuss and give a quote including the actual selection of accessories.

report_summary:
Report on BMW Showroom Experience at KUN Moteoren Pvt Ltd, Nandagiri Hills, Hyderabad

Introduction:
On 30 June 2023 I visited the BMW showroom located at Nandagiri Hills, Hyderabad, operated by KUN Moteoren Pvt Ltd. My initial excitement to audit the showroom turned into disappointment as the experience failed to meet my expectations. This report aims to provide an overview of my experience and highlight the areas where improvements are necessary.

Greeting and Product Inquiry:
Upon entering the showroom, I was greeted by Pravalika, who promptly attended to me. I expressed my interest in the BMW X3 model and was introduced to the salesperson, Sarath Perumall, who began explaining the product.

Product Presentation:
Sarath Perumall utilized a touch screen to explain the differences between the petrol and diesel versions of the vehicle. While the basic information was provided, I found the presentation lacking in detail. Sarath did not proactively offer information on various features and options. Instead, I had to consistently inquire and prompt him for further details. This lack of proactive engagement was a significant drawback in the sales process.

Finance and EMI Options:
During the discussion, Sarath explained the finance and EMI options available for purchasing the BMW X3. However, his pitch in this aspect was also underwhelming. I did not feel convinced or adequately informed about the financial aspects of the purchase. The lack of a comprehensive explanation on financing options diminished the overall sales experience.

Test Drive and Documentation:
Sarath promised to arrange a test drive on the same day. Unfortunately, this commitment was not fulfilled, leaving me disappointed. Additionally, he assured me that brochures and other necessary documents would be shared with me via WhatsApp. Regrettably, I have yet to receive these materials, even after more than 24 hours have passed. The failure to follow through on these commitments created a negative impression and indicated a lack of attention to customer satisfaction.

Conclusion:
Based on my visit to the BMW showroom at KUN Moteoren Pvt Ltd, it is evident that improvements are necessary to enhance the overall customer experience. The lack of proactive engagement, insufficient explanation of features, failure to arrange a promised test drive, and the delay in sharing essential documents all contribute to a subpar sales process. As a potential customer, I would not be inclined to purchase a vehicle under these circumstances.

Recommendations:
1. Proactive Engagement: Salespersons should be trained to actively provide comprehensive information about the vehicles, features, and options without relying solely on customer inquiries.
2. Thorough Product Presentation: Salespersons should take the initiative to present all the relevant details and features of the vehicles to potential customers, leaving no important aspects unaddressed.
3. Fulfill Commitments: It is crucial for the sales team to follow through on promised actions promptly. Test drives should be arranged as agreed, and documents should be shared without delay.
4. Timely Follow-up: The dealership should establish a system for regular customer follow-up to ensure that potential buyers' queries are addressed promptly and efficiently.

By implementing these recommendations, the BMW showroom at KUN Moteoren Pvt Ltd can significantly enhance the customer experience and increase the likelihood of converting interested visitors into satisfied customers.

I booked my appointment with Cars24 on 19th August 2023 but the CJ assigned was repeated (confirmed by Project Manager - Aastha). So I rescheduled it to the next day 20th August 2023 for slot 3:00 PM to 4:00 PM but CJ's details were not shared with me till 4:15 PM. I called customer care for the issue as well, They said that I would get an instant message but that was not the case. After CJ arrived he took me for a test ride and after that, he started the car inspection in which he mainly clicked photos of the car from different angles and asked me a few questions about car accidents. CJ was kind of talkative but he did have good knowledge of car/car repair. From the next day onwards I got calls from RA to negotiate for price Initially they valued my car very less (Rs.2,05,000) and made me believe that because of the accident, my car value may not be more than (2,70,000). PLL RA didn't promise any price he was adamant about the price(Rs.2,70,000).
The major issue I faced during all calls was that all the associates told me that their name was Kiran/Karan which I believe was not the case. RA initially called me without any reports and asked my desired price, he did promise to get Rs.3,00,000 but the next time when he or some other RA called me he said that 3,00,000 was not possible.
I asked CJ and RA if they could suggest someone outside cars24 to sell or buy my car to which both replied that it is illegal and they are not allowed to do so.
Overall my experience with Cars24 was very good but there were a few lacks which may be corrected and can be ignored by others.

Edited on 25-August-2023

After asking them how they got my details they told me that these details are online and it is like telemarketers call us (attaching recording and call log ). He already had my car details like my mobile number, name, and expected price and offered the price. He had some report details as well I assume (attaching recording and call log). He provided a fair valuation of my car and explained the factors influencing the price. His transparency made me feel comfortable throughout the process. Exterior and Entrance:
The exterior of the showroom was well-marked with visible signs directing customers to the entrances. The entrance carpet was clean and well-maintained, and the window display was inviting, encouraging customers to enter and visualize the products.

Interior and Overall Store Ambiance:
The interior of the showroom was well-lit, earning a rating of 4 out of 5 for lighting. The overall cleanliness was impressive, with frames, equipment, seating areas, and walkways being dust-free and well-maintained. The walls featured attractive color variants, contributing to the visual appeal. However, there was room for improvement in the cleanliness and sanitization of waste bins, and some minor discrepancies were noted in the restrooms.

Staff Grooming:
The staff, led by Mr. Vikas Singh, exhibited impeccable grooming standards. They were dressed in business formals and wore company ID cards. Mr. Singh, despite an unusual initial interaction, demonstrated professionalism and was courteous throughout the visit.

Need Analysis and Customer Handling:
The staff used polite and professional language and actively listened to my requirements. They offered excellent customer service, explained the product thoroughly, and provided a product demonstration. While the salesperson did not initially introduce himself, he eventually shared his name and designation.

Post-Visit Follow-up:
The quality of post-visit follow-up was rated as average. A follow-up call was received three days after the visit, along with prompt brochure delivery within 24 hours.

Sentimental Analysis:
Overall, I felt well-attended and appreciated the excellent assistance from the staff. The store ambiance was impressive, although some cleanliness areas needed attention. Nibav Homelifts was acknowledged for its safety standards, but pricing was noted as possibly higher than expected, potentially affecting its market perception.

report_summary: No appointments were made. I went directly to the store. On entry, the reception staff enquired whether the agent was there to check out a car, then proceeded to know the model the agent was looking for along with my name, mobile number and mail ID. In a minute, Mr. Punit came to assist. He asked me which model we were looking for and asked whether we wanted tea or coffee. He then asked whether we'd like to have them now or after seeing the car. Then he took me near to the car. The A-Class was parked outside the compound. He then started the car and explained every feature of the car. This includes the keyless entry, 3 seat adjustment memory, 64 ambient lightings, 7 gear DCT, driving modes, fuel economy, boot opening by foot gesture, infotainment system, 189-degree camera with 360-degree sensors, parking assist, braking assist etc. He also explained that they give an 8-year warranty on the Engine. He also explained a few discount offers and Meet Dhoni's offer. He proceeded to ask my professional to see if they could avail discounts. He further asked whether I wished to test drive the car. When I said yes, he took the car inside and took me to the Mercedes Cafe. I was given the requested beverages, along with a few cookies and sugar. On processing the gate pass, I asked questions on how this car differs from the competitors, and he suggested that it has the best-in-class fuel economy and comfort that the competitors cannot provide, along with a pretty performance engine. He also suggested that there are a tonne of feature updates this year that the competitors do not have. He also suggested that I would understand these after the test drive. He then took a picture of the license and was given a few acknowledgment forms to read and sign at the end. He then took me to the car, and on the way, he inquired whether I had ever driven a DCT. He also explained the DCT and how it works. I drove the car on the designated path or route mentioned by the staff. He also showed different features and modes. At the end, he asked if we would like an exchange and asked about the vehicle we own. He said that they can give a price after an inspection, which can be done at home or the dealership. He also said that he could drive to my home on another day to show it to my family. Once we finished up with the test drive, we sat again in the cafe and started discussing the price and booking. I said that I'd like to book in the name of my father. He also asked about the profession to avail of a discount. I said that he was from Marico Limited, but on searching, the staff showed a list of institutions in India and asked whether I belonged to any of them. The list consisted of different professional categories like architects, doctors, etc. I said that his dad comes under the architect category. The staff suggested that we could avail of a discount of Rs. 3 lakh. It used to be Rs. 1.5 lakh, but there is an offer, and hence it is Rs. 3 lakh. The staff said that this was a corporate offer. I stressed this further to know if there is a separate corporate or professional offer by asking about different professions and MNCs, but the staff said that they all come under the corporate one. I also asked for the diesel variant, for which he said that it's open for pre-booking and the prices are expected to be around Rs. 50 lakh.He also suggested that I would miss out on a lot of offers if we were to wait for the diesel one. He then explained the Star Agility program and asked the agent to choose a ram. I said that the vehicle wouldn't run a lot, so the basic program was enough. He said that the Star Agility program offers an interest rate of only 6.99% if we book within 2 months, and it also reduces the EMI by 50%. Star Finance would have an interest rate of 8.9%. When asked why I should choose internal finance over external finance, the staff said that the interest rates would be similar or only higher than their internal loans. Also, this would be more convenient and less time-consuming. When asked about accessories, he suggested that we can look into those once we finalize them and showed me the price list. He also said that if booked this month, the insurance premium for this year would be waived. He also mentioned at the start that Mercedes streamlined their booking process, and now all bookings are online and can be done by the customer. This stopped the price variation within different dealerships. When asked for discounts, he mentioned the same. Upon further pushing on discounts, he said that I am getting a Rs. 50 lakh cars and how would it make a difference in saving a few thousand? They had provided water bottles during this conversation. The star agility and star finance quotes were given in hard and soft copy. He then thanked and said that if he missed anything, I could call anytime.

Mystery Audit Report for Tattva Spa in Kakkanad, Kochi, Kerala:

On the 9th of October, 2023, at 4:40 PM, I had the pleasure of experiencing a spa session at Tattva Spa in Kakkanad, Kochi, Kerala, with a voucher amounting to Rs. 3,540, which I had redeemed through a gift voucher. The entire experience, from the moment I called to book my appointment, was exceptional and well worth recounting in detail.

The reservation process, initiated on the 8th of October, 2023, at 3:16 PM, was seamless. I spoke with a staff member named Prince, who, while efficient, missed an opportunity to introduce himself or provide information about the spa and its location. However, he quickly confirmed the date and time I requested for my therapy, which was set for 4:30 PM the following day.

During the call, Prince confirmed that this was my first visit to Tattva Spa and requested my name and mobile number for their records. He proceeded to clearly explain the service duration, prices, and the key benefits of the Swedish SPA therapy I had chosen. Prince's courteous demeanor extended to thanking me for choosing Tattva Spa, and he ensured clear communication throughout the booking process. His speech was notably clear, well-paced, and devoid of jargon, enhancing the overall booking experience.

Prince, displaying good salesmanship, made a concerted effort to upsell additional services. He suggested upgrades to a 90-minute spa therapy and introduced me to spa membership plans, demonstrating excellent selling skills rooted in the benefits these offerings could bring to me as a customer. He also mentioned the availability of spa gift cards, providing a comprehensive overview of the offerings.

Upon my arrival at the spa on the 9th of October, I was greeted by Prince, who exhibited professionalism and hospitality. He promptly confirmed my reservation in the system, offered me a comfortable seat, and extended a warm welcome with a refreshing drink. Prince also took the time to introduce me to the various aromatherapy oils available, allowing me to select my preference. The spa's ambiance was inviting, featuring calming music and a distinct aroma, which immediately set the tone for relaxation and comfort upon entry.

Prince's informative introduction to the benefits of the different oils was a nice touch, helping me make an informed choice. The wait time before my therapy, which did not exceed 10 minutes, was managed effectively. Prince also communicated with the spa therapist, Manisha, to ensure that my specific requirements were taken into account. He presented me with an assessment form to fill and sign, covering all necessary pre-therapy formalities.

My therapist, Manisha, maintained the high standard set by the spa. She was attired in uniform, presented herself as well-groomed, and greeted me with a warm and welcoming smile. Manisha's execution of the Swedish SPA therapy was nothing short of exemplary, characterized by a gentle yet invigorating massage that included mild stretching and movement up and down my body. However, she did not mention the bag of worry during the session.

Before initiating the therapy, Manisha thoughtfully offered me a change of clothes, respecting my privacy by discreetly leaving the room for me to change and returning after 5 minutes. Additionally, she placed a bowl with flowers below the headrest, enhancing the overall atmosphere and attention to detail.

The therapy experience was marked by its quality and attention to detail. Manisha ensured that pressure points were checked and that I was comfortable at all times. She answered any queries I had and maintained a professional and respectful distance during the therapy session. Throughout the entire process, Manisha displayed professionalism, ensuring my comfort and privacy, and leaving no room for discomfort or unease.

After the therapy concluded, the transition to post-therapy was handled smoothly. I was offered green tea, and Prince, at the reception, thanked me for visiting. He also ensured that I had collected all my belongings and provided a hassle-free billing process. The option to use the spa gift card was convenient, and the bill was provided without the need for me to request it. Importantly, the final amount matched what I had been advised during the booking.

In summary, my experience at Tattva Spa in Kakkanad was nothing short of delightful and highly appreciated. The professionalism, hospitality, and exceptional service provided by the team, especially Prince and Manisha, left an indelible impression. The audit encompassed an assessment of both the sales and onboarding processes for Foundit. Here's a comprehensive summary of our key findings:

1. Sales Interaction:

The lead submission was a two-step process. Initially, the lead was submitted on their website on October 6th, which triggered an automated response prompting us to create a recruiter profile. However, our recruiter profile was declined after 24 hours. The actual sales interaction commenced when we contacted them via a toll-free telephone call on October 9th.
Sales interactions occurred from October 9th to October 11th. Initially, Mr. Saikiran, the Sales staff, advised against a subscription due to the pricing, but we insisted on exploring Foundit products, and he professionally guided us through the purchase process.
We purchased a 1-month NON-IT Resume Database Access, which included one master login and 10 complementary premium job postings.
2. Post Sales Interaction Follow-up:
The sales team proactively followed up within 24 hours when there was no initial interest shown within the first 48 hours. The follow-up continued for at least 48 hours after our initial interaction.
3. Product Purchase Process:

Upon confirming the purchase, both the sales and compliance teams promptly requested essential documents, including GST papers, Aadhar card, PAN card, and a digital signature to facilitate the Know Your Customer (KYC) process. The KYC procedure was estimated to be completed within 24 hours, assuring efficiency. Additionally, there were no instances of false promises or exaggerated claims concerning additional benefits. The sales team remained firm on not extending benefits beyond the standard offerings. However, a Rs. 2000 discount was negotiated, effectively reducing the overall price of the product. Notably, no information was provided regarding a refund policy, and it was expected that all required documents and KYC details would be submitted within a 24-hour timeframe.4. KYC and Payment Process:

5. Onboarding and Training Process:

The onboarding process encountered notable delays, where login details were shared post-payment, but no further discussions or actions pertaining to onboarding took place. Additionally, the onboarding message sent after a five-day interval lacked substantial guidance, contributing to a lack of clarity in the process. The onboarding team exhibited a deficiency in both proactiveness and knowledge, thereby impeding their ability to provide effective guidance and support. Furthermore, specific contact details for the product support team were not provided, potentially causing communication challenges. It's worth noting that, despite these issues, there were no instances of misbehavior. However, the overall onboarding process received a poor rating, reflecting inefficiencies and a noticeable absence of comprehensive customer support.

In summary, while the sales process demonstrated transparency and flexibility in accommodating customer requirements, the onboarding and training process suffered from a lack of proactiveness, knowledge, and efficiency, resulting in an overall poor experience. There is a clear need for improvements in the onboarding and support aspects of Foundit's services.

Product Support and Communication: I did not receive proactive reminders or support communication after the product purchase. It took a significant amount of time for the support team to reach out regarding product usage issues.

Query Resolution: While the support team was generally supportive and available, some queries, specifically related to job posting details, remained unsolved, indicating a potential gap in assistance.

Communication Channels: My primary communication channel with the support team was email, and there was a limited range of options to connect with them.

Overall Experience: My overall experience with the brand, from lead submission to product support, is rated as 'Average,' reflecting a neutral sentiment.

Compliance Department: The compliance department's communication and timely actions also received an 'Average' rating.

Staff Handling Skills: I rated staff handling skills as 'Average,' suggesting a need for potential improvement in this area.

Positive Findings: The brand was noted for its fast selling process, aggressive sales team, and appealing portal platform layout, enhancing my user experience.

Negative Findings: Negative observations included a sale and forget approach, lack of proper onboarding for new customers, teamwork issues, and challenges in the recruitment process.

Misbehavior: I did not observe any misbehavior during the overall process check.

Future Purchase Preference: I expressed no preference for purchasing products from the brand in the future, indicating room for improvement to regain my trust and loyalty.

In conclusion, the survey highlights a mixed experience, with both positive and negative aspects in my journey with the brand. The brand should focus on enhancing product support, communication, and onboarding to ensure a more positive experience and potential future business with me

During the audit, I made two calls to Tattva Spa's Bangalore branch via their website, tattvaspa.com. The first call had a voice issue, so I made a second attempt. On the second call, I spoke with a customer representative named Balwinder (CR-Balwinder).

I inquired about the range of services offered, their respective benefits, and the associated prices. Balwindr provided information about the types of massages, including details about the pressure used in each therapy. I requested a booking for a Swedish massage and inquired about any available discounts. He mentioned there were no ongoing discounts but offered a 10% discount if I paid with a gift card. After I requested a higher discount, he agreed to a 15% discount, not exceeding that amount.

A confirmed booking was made for me at Tattva Spa - Courtyard by Mariott Hotel, Bangalore, at 7:00 PM. However, I canceled the therapy appointment two hours later, at 5:00 PM, as per the audit findings.
In addition, I'd like to note that there is room for improvement in the customer representative's (CR) promotion of services and discounts. While the CR provided helpful responses, there's an opportunity to enhance the promotion of available services and discounts to potential customers.

Furthermore, it's worth highlighting that the voice quality during calls to Tattva Spa was consistently subpar, which could be a point of concern. Therefore, there are multiple aspects that could benefit from refinement to ensure a better customer experience. The CR's responsiveness is commendable, but there is certainly room for enhancement.

**Report Summary: Indeed Product Purchase & Post-Purchase Assessment**

**1. Audit Details:**
   - **Lead Submission:** The lead was submitted on September 7, with acknowledgment received on the same day. Subsequent email interactions occurred on September 8, 14, and 15, with limited progress as we awaited an executive from Indeed. Shifting from email to their toll-free number, we engaged with Ms. Rebecca. After an initial lack of cooperation, a successful interaction occurred on the 8th, and Ms. Shivani took over to complete the process.
   - **Sales Interaction:** Sales interactions took place on November 8, 21, and 23.
   - **Purchased Product:** A Standard Subscription with 30 contacts per month was purchased at ₹8000 per month.

**2. Post-Sales Interaction Follow-up:**
   - The sales team did not follow up within 48 hours when there was no initial interest in purchasing.
   - Interactions involved three executives: Ms. Rebecca, Ms. Laxmi, and Ms. Shivani, with Ms. Shivani being the most involved.
   - No follow-up occurred within 48 hours from the sales team after the initial interaction.

**3. Product Purchase Process:**
   - Confirmation of product purchase required acknowledgment, digital signature verification, and DocuSign signature for documents.
   - The KYC procedure was completed instantly through an online process.
   - Despite a request to modify product specifications, the company maintained the initial offering.
   - No false assurances or promises of additional benefits were given.
   - Refund policy details were not provided.
   - Submission of documents for KYC was requested as early as possible.

**4. KYC and Payment Process:**
   - The process was system-driven through DocuSign; no request for specific documents was made.
   - Correct but incomplete documents were guided by Ms. Shivani through email.
   - No specific response was provided for document submission delays or requirement changes.
   - The proposal was received within the promised timeline.
   - No agreement was reached on reducing product pricing in the proposal.

**5. Onboarding and Training Process:**
   - Contact for onboarding and product activation was immediate after online signature and purchase.
   The onboarding process involved steps on the Indeed website for subscription management and seat assignment.
   - Proactive help and knowledgeable guidance were provided by the onboarding team.
   - The team demonstrated understanding and addressed queries effectively.
   - Contact details for product support were provided.
   - No misbehavior was observed during the onboarding process.
   - Overall onboarding process rated as Good (4 out of 5).

**Conclusion:**
The overall experience with Indeed's product purchase and onboarding was a mix of initial challenges followed by improved responses, efficient processes, prompt responses, and a transparent approach. Challenges were noted in modifying product specifications, and the sales team lacked proactive follow-up within 48 hours. The onboarding process received a favorable rating of 4 out of 5, indicating a satisfactory experience. The sales executives demonstrated a non-aggressive and non-persuasive approach, resembling government agencies rather than being proactive.

B.	Negotiation Approach: During price negotiation, the mention of other local dealers was declined, citing company policy.

Opinion for Mr. Amit Singh
A.	Loyalty: He appears loyal to the company.
B.	Client Interaction: The overall behavior and conversation with Mr. Ravi were satisfactory. 

Conclusion:

The overall experience with CARS24 was positive. Both Mr. Amit Singh and Mr. Ravi demonstrated commitment to their roles, with minor areas identified for improvement in client interactions. The employees performed well during the inspection and negotiation processes.

SPECIAL COMPARISION ANALYSIS BETWEEN Indeed Vs. LinkedIn AS RECRUITMENT PLATFORM AS PER MY OBSERVATION.

LinkedIn and Indeed are two popular platforms used by recruiters for sourcing candidates, but they serve different purposes and have distinct features. Here's a comparison from a recruiter's perspective:

**1. User Base and Demographics:**
   - **LinkedIn:** Known as a professional networking site, LinkedIn attracts a user base consisting of professionals, including those actively looking for jobs and passive candidates. Recruiters can search for candidates based on their skills, experience, and professional background.
   - **Indeed:** A job board with a diverse user base, Indeed caters to both active and passive job seekers. It attracts a wide range of candidates across various industries and skill levels.

**2. Job Postings:**
   - **LinkedIn:** Allows recruiters to post jobs directly on the platform and promote them to a targeted audience. Jobs are shared with the recruiter's network and can be featured in job seekers' feeds.
   - **Indeed:** Primarily a job board, Indeed allows recruiters to post job openings that can be easily discovered by job seekers through the platform's search functionality.

**3. Networking and Relationship Building:**
   - **LinkedIn:** Offers a robust platform for networking and building professional relationships. Recruiters can connect with potential candidates directly, join relevant groups, and participate in industry discussions.
   - **Indeed:** While it focuses more on job listings, Indeed does allow some networking capabilities. However, it's not as extensive as LinkedIn in terms of building professional connections.

**4. Resume Database:**
   - **LinkedIn:** Provides access to a vast database of user profiles, including detailed resumes. Recruiters can search for candidates based on specific criteria and reach out directly.
   - **Indeed:** Offers a resume database, but access may be limited based on subscription plans. Recruiters can find candidates through Indeed's search functionality.

**5. Cost:**
   - **LinkedIn:** Typically has a higher cost for job postings and premium features. It may be more suitable for recruiters with a larger budget.
   - **Indeed:** Generally offers a cost-effective solution for job postings. It's known for its pay-per-click model, where recruiters pay for the visibility and clicks on their job postings & also the subscription model right from monthly to yearly subscription.

**6. Candidate Engagement:**
   - **LinkedIn:** Facilitates direct communication with candidates through messages, InMail, and comments on posts. Recruiters can engage with potential hires in a more interactive way.
   - **Indeed:** Communication tends to be more transactional, often occurring through the application process or initial contact regarding a specific job posting.

**Conclusion:**
LinkedIn is more focused on professional networking and relationship-building, making it suitable for recruiters who prioritize a candidate's professional background and connections. Indeed, on the other hand, is a robust job board that caters to a broad audience of job seekers and offers cost-effective solutions for recruiters looking to fill positions quickly. Recruiters often use both platforms in their strategies, depending on their specific hiring needs and goals.

The staff’s enthusiasm was noted to be lacking, which could have been due to the audit being conducted on a Tuesday night. Staff motivation and engagement are crucial for creating a welcoming and enjoyable environment for visitors. Therefore, measures to boost staff morale and maintain high energy levels throughout the week are suggested.

The instructions provided on the game machines were not clear, leading to confusion and wasted attempts. For complex games, it is recommended that a trial round be allocated or an instructional video be provided. This would help players understand the game mechanics better and enhance their gaming experience.

The game ‘Hit the Clown’ was a highlight of the visit, providing great enjoyment. However, there was disappointment over losing the ‘Candy Crane’ game without even getting a chance to try it. It is suggested that all games be made accessible to visitors to ensure a fair and comprehensive gaming experience.

Despite these issues, the overall experience was positive. The variety of games and the general ambiance of the arcade made for an enjoyable visit. There is a strong desire to revisit the arcade, indicating its potential and appeal. With the suggested improvements, the arcade can significantly enhance its visitor experience and satisfaction.

For a brand like Porsche, it is crucial that the showroom is located in a prime area of the city, and fortunately, this is the case. The showroom is situated in an excellent location. Upon arrival, the showroom immediately caught my attention with its appealing exterior, exuding a positive and inviting atmosphere. The exterior design of the showroom exudes class and elegance, effectively representing the brand's values.

As I entered, I was warmly greeted by the receptionist who made me feel welcome. They kindly offered me a cup of coffee, ensuring that I was well taken care of during my visit.

The showroom itself was impeccably clean and well-maintained, with the displayed car positioned elegantly, capturing the attention of all who entered. There was also a display shop that offered a variety of accessories and clothing. This was a great addition as it complemented the showroom ambiance and enhanced the overall customer experience, especially during wait times.

The time it took for the salesperson to introduce himself was incredibly quick , within couple of minutes . I was introduced to Anthony Ronald, a salesperson who warmly greeted me. The employee was dressed professionally .He asked about my needs and made an effort to understand what I was looking for in a purchase. During our interaction, he displayed genuine interest in understanding my requirements and preferences for a purchase. Regrettably, he overlooked the crucial aspect of determining my time available for the consultation.

He inquired about the car I currently owned and tried to determine if I was new to the luxury car segment. While he wasn't pushy about the purchase, he could have highlighted lot more benefits for Porsche Macan. 

He could have explained the differentiating factors between Porsche Macan and other brands available. It would have been beneficial for him to provide a more thorough explanation which was missing . I started to perceive a hint of doubt in his demeanour, as if he was unsure about my potential as a buyer.

I asked him about the other competitive brands available in the market and examined how they differ from our competitors. I did tell him that there are other brands offering similar features, but what sets this car apart? He explained the true potential of the car's price, elegance, and comfort, and he was confident about it and how does it really meet the experience pf someone who really is fond driving . The presentation gave a sense that the sales person had great confidence in the product's quality, particularly its speed and power. He had an understanding of the competitors and provided a rough sight of the differentiation. However, he seemed to be quite selective in highlighting the car's most outstanding features and qualities.

When it came to the test drive, he was incredibly supportive and, in fact, encouraged me to take it. It seemed like he understood the true potential of the car's price, elegance, and comfort, and he was confident about it. During the test drive, he even urged me to accelerate and fully experience the power of this remarkable machine.

Furthermore, he provided me with an idea of the pricing and financing options available but this was not discussed in details ,  we did not delve into specifics . 

There was no physical copy of the catalogue, which is understandable. However, the digital copy could be shared in real-time. I was given  the information  that the details would be sent via email.
The quotation was expected to be sent via email, but it has not been sent as of the day of the visit. He mentioned that there are financing options available, but we didn't discuss the specifics. I have not yet received the details that were supposed to be sent via email, even though 24 hours have passed since the audit date. However, due to the impending deadline for report submission, I am submitting the report to meet the deadline. Follow up has not been done yet .

The tax concerning the cost can vary significantly, which may discourage potential buyers from making the purchase. While the buyer may be willing to pay for most of the cost, additional taxation can result in a significant increase in the final price. Navigating the delicate balance of questioning a customer's needs can be quite challenging, especially for those venturing into this segment for the first time. It is crucial to tread carefully on this fine line.  I got a feeling that I was not been perceived as serious buyer . 

The overall quality of the establishment, its workers, and the team was good. The car's quality and test drive experience were exceptional. Despite small jitters , the overall experience was good.

Overall Impression:
The mystery shopping visit uncovered a positive customer experience at Porsche  .The staff demonstrated professionalism, and the sales process was customer-centric, thereby contributing to a favourable impression.

Nevertheless, there are certain areas that could benefit from improvement. These aspects highlight the distinctive factors of the car and provide compelling reasons for its purchase.

Areas for Improvement:
1. Encourage staff to proactively discuss financing options and address potential customer concerns.
2. Ensure consistent adherence to the follow-up procedures outlined during the mystery shopping visit.
3. Explain the benefits in detail so that the buyer can have a better understanding of the features and be enticed to purchase the car. 
4. Additionally, it would be beneficial to enhance enthusiasm.

Conclusion:
Based on the results of the mystery shopping audit, it is evident that Porsche showroom is currently providing a commendable customer experience. However, there are still areas where improvements can be made to enhance service quality and maintain positive interactions with potential customers.

To begin with, it is crucial to encourage our staff to take a proactive approach in discussing financing options with customers and addressing any concerns they may have. By doing so, we can ensure that potential buyers feel well-informed and confident in their decision-making process.

Additionally, it is essential to emphasize the importance of consistent adherence to the follow-up procedures outlined during the mystery shopping visit. This will help us maintain a high level of professionalism and ensure that no potential leads slip through the cracks.

The salesperson needs to be bit more enthusiastic while pitching the car . He should showcase and describe the numerous benefits of the car in details , providing customers with compelling reasons to make a purchase.

By implementing these recommendations, we can further elevate our customer service standards and create an even more satisfying experience for our valued customers.

report_summary:
i4 eDrive 35 M Sport
It was a Sunday, so I made the decision to schedule an appointment before heading to the showroom. I attempted to reach them before 10:00 am, but unfortunately, the IVR answered the call without anyone picking up. I decided to try again after 11:00 am, and this time, my call was promptly answered with minimal wait time. He warmly interacted with me and we successfully booked an appointment for the upcoming day. His friendly demeanour made the whole process more pleasant. Upon arrival, I noticed that the digital signage was strategically placed and easily visible. The support staff was kind enough to assist me in finding a parking spot for my car. Furthermore, I was impressed by the overall cleanliness and maintenance of the establishment. For a brand like BMW, it is crucial that the showroom is located in a prime area of the city, and fortunately, this is the case. The showroom is situated in an excellent location. Upon arrival, the showroom immediately caught my attention with its appealing exterior, exuding a positive and inviting atmosphere. The exterior design of the showroom exudes class and elegance, effectively representing the brand's values. As I entered, I was warmly greeted by the security who made me feel welcome.  The time it took for the salesperson to introduce himself was incredibly quick , within couple of minutes . I was introduced to Himanth Yadav  ,  a salesperson who warmly greeted me. The employee was dressed professionally .He asked about my needs and made an effort to understand what I was looking for in a purchase. During our interaction, he displayed genuine interest in understanding my requirements and preferences for a purchase. The showroom itself was impeccably clean and well-maintained, with the displayed car positioned elegantly, capturing the attention of all who entered. There was also a display shop that offered a variety of accessories and clothing. This was a great addition as it complemented the showroom ambiance and enhanced the overall customer experience, especially during wait times. They kindly offered me a refreshment and asked for my preference, which I declined. However, the support staff still made sure to place a bottle of water on the table near where I was seated. He explained the differentiating factors between BMW Car and other brands available. I asked him about the other competitive brands available in the market and examined how they differ from our competitors. I did tell him that there are other brands offering similar features, but what sets this car apart? He explained the true potential of the car's price, elegance, and comfort, and he was confident about it and how does it really meet the experience pf someone who really is fond driving . The presentation gave a sense that the sales person had great confidence in the product's quality, particularly its speed and power. He had an understanding of the competitors and provided a sight of the differentiations. When it came to the test drive, he was incredibly supportive and, in fact, encouraged me to take it. It seemed like he understood the true potential of the car's price, elegance, and comfort, and he was confident about it. During the test drive, he even urged me to experience the class of this remarkable machine. The sales person I spoke with was incredibly knowledgeable and addressed all of my inquiries regarding electric vehicles. We delved into various aspects, including concerns about range, alerts, drawbacks, infrastructure readiness, cost benefit analysis in comparison to traditional petrol/diesel cars, charging stations, and sustainability in charging infrastructure. Not only did he provide transparent insights into the advantages, but he also offered valuable suggestions on how to overcome the existing challenges in this field. We also received information about the electric vehicle configuration and other important details.  The range of the vehicle is approximately 482 kilometres, although this may vary depending on the driving pattern. In Bangalore, there are numerous charging stations available, but if we plan to travel outside the city, we need to consider this in advance. Fortunately, there is an app that provides information on charging stations. When it comes to charging the vehicle, it typically takes around 25 to 30 minutes to charge from 10% to 80%, depending on the type of charger, particularly the DC charger is better. The vehicle will provide an indication when the battery is running low, allowing us to plan accordingly. Trip planning is crucial for electric vehicles. One of the advantages of owning an electric vehicle is the minimal servicing cost. Additionally, the battery comes with a warranty of 8 years or 1 lakh 60 thousand kilometres. After carefully calculating the cost benefits of an electric vehicle compared to a petrol engine, we realized that the savings are substantial. The math was done, taking into account my usage, and I found the cost to be convincing. He did mention that India is ready for the EV market but has to plan the trip well . We had a productive discussion about the available pricing ,financing options and availability . In great detail, he provided me with pricing information for model around petrol and diesel variants, as well as how they compared to the electric version. On Sunday, the finance team was unavailable, preventing him from sharing the extensive quotation. However, he assured me that he would personally follow up and ensure that it would be sent to my email address.

However, since the management team was unavailable on Sunday, they assured us that they would follow up with us and address the financial details. Unfortunately, the specific quotation and availability of certain features were not shared during my visit due to the unavailability of the finance team on the weekend. The salesperson was unable to provide information about the discount as he believed that factors such as availability and colour options would play a role in determining the pricing. He provided me with the on-road pricing, which amounted to 96,000 rupees as the initial cost for a 3-year EMI plan for a loan of 30 Lakhs . However, he mentioned that he would provide more specific details at a later time after gathering my information . The salesperson did call me back on January 16th and sent me the details on the quotations. The updated cost was Rupees 77,523.05. Furthermore, he thoroughly explained the company's buyback plan, highlighting how it aligns with buyers' budgets and the advantages it offers. He emphasized the various choices available to buyers who opt for this plan, making it an enticing option for those entering the luxury segment market for the first time. BMW 360 Finance was explained by the salesperson on the context  : Pay for What You Use, with Assured Buy Back Value Agreed Upon from the Start. Choose to Retain, Resell, or Refinance. A revolutionary payment plan that allows you to pay only for what you use. With this innovative financing option, you can enjoy the luxury of driving a BMW while having the flexibility to decide the future of your vehicle. One of the key benefits of BMW 360 Finance is the assured buy back value, which is agreed upon right from the beginning. This means that you can rest assured knowing the value of your BMW when the time comes to part ways. Whether you choose to retain the vehicle, resell it, or refinance, the decision is entirely up to you. Does provide freedom of driving a BMW without the worry of depreciation or uncertain resale values. With BMW 360 Finance, you have the power to make informed decisions about your vehicle's future. Whether you want to keep it for the long haul, sell it for a new model, or refinance for a different financial arrangement, the choice is yours. Not only does BMW 360 Finance provide you with financial flexibility, but it also ensures a professional and seamless experience. The salesperson demonstrated a commendable level of knowledge. The overall quality of the establishment, its workers, and the team was good. The car's quality and test drive experience were exceptional.
Exterior Presentation:
The showroom's exterior was impeccably maintained, exuding a highly professional image. Prominent signage and branding were strategically placed, effectively communicating the dealership's unique identity.
Interior Ambiance:
The showroom's interior exuded an air of cleanliness and impeccable organization, instantly creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The carefully curated lighting and thoughtfully arranged displays worked harmoniously to effectively showcase the stunning array of cars on offer.

Overall Impression:
The mystery shopping visit uncovered a positive customer experience at BMW   .The staff demonstrated professionalism, and the sales process was customer-centric, thereby contributing to a favourable impression.

By implementing these recommendations, we can further elevate our customer service standards and create an even more satisfying experience for our valued customers.

Bangalore - Koramangala, Bangalore
GR Icon, 2nd Floor, No 90 Industrialist Area, Jyoti Nivas College Rd, 5th Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560034.

 Packages are:

report_summary: Since the Audit was conducted late in the morning/early afternoon the store was practically empty with almost no other customers. The product display at the store was well organised and easy to understand with their informative price stickers visible. Before entering the store, at the entrance I overheard the store manager communicating to two of his employees about the lack of any sales for a long time and asking them to not let go of any customer without a sale. By the looks of it and the experience later, they seemed desperate. I decided to enter the store and take some pictures for the Audit report before I started the audio recording and conversing with the salesperson. While at the TV section, since I was one of the only customers at the store so all eyes were on me with the salespersons standing around me offering their assistance. I stated my business that I was there looking for a TV for a hotel business and needed 2 min before I would approach them on my own or ask for their assistance. Unfortunately, even after repeatedly asking for 2 min, very clearly indicating for some space, the salespersons closely followed me everywhere. As I was getting done with the photos, the manager had approached me offering his assistance. Before I could introduce myself and state my business, looking at the Google sheet open on my phone, he asked if this was an Audit. Seems like the manager had prior information that there was an audit being conducted. I played dumb asking “Sorry?” and after a pause to his silence, I stated that I was there on behalf of a Hotel looking for some TV’s. At this point, I wanted to start the audio recording but again the manager did not give me any space and was closely following me around. I went along with the conversation stating that we are in need of 20 TVs for some of our rooms and the Google Sheet was for the model price details to help the finance team to decide in accordance with their budget. The way the conversation went ahead, it indicated that he treated me as a genuine customer. I was asked a lot of questions like the hotel name and TV size requirements. Thinking that I was from a Star Hotel whose name I had mentioned. He suggested not to go with the 33-inch televisions as they appear to be very small and instead suggested going with the 55-inch TV. At this point, I indicated that the Google Sheet was a mandatory requirement for me to fill in the details and that I would approach him for his recommendation and the final Quotation once I was done noting down the details of all the models available for the interested TV size. After getting done with Google Sheets I was able to start the audio recording before approaching him again for the final details. In the end, when it came to the quotation and finance options, although I selected the SAMSUNG 55 UHD SMART LED TV to Audit their service, they were not very clear about the finance options available and insisted on emailing me the final quotation with the discount after I finalised my mode of payment. However, as a consumer, I would like to understand which option serves me best before selecting my mode of payment. As such no clear offer or Scheme was properly discussed. But they insisted on making the purchase before the 27th since the discounted price mentioned on the price stickers will be coming to an end.

Upon arrival, I noticed that the digital signage was strategically placed and easily visible. The support staff was kind enough to assist me in finding a parking spot for my car. Furthermore, I was impressed by the overall cleanliness and maintenance of the establishment.

The showroom is situated in an excellent location. Upon arrival, the showroom immediately caught my attention with its appealing exterior, exuding a positive and inviting atmosphere. The exterior design of the showroom exudes class and elegance, effectively representing the varied brands . 

The time it took for the salesperson to introduce himself was incredibly quick , within couple of minutes . I was introduced to Das , a salesperson who warmly greeted me. The employee was dressed professionally .He asked about my needs and made an effort to understand what I was looking for in a purchase. During our interaction, he displayed genuine interest in understanding my requirements and preferences for a purchase. 

The showroom itself was impeccably clean and well-maintained, with the displayed TVs  positioned elegantly, capturing the attention of all who entered. 

An extensive collection of televisions adorned the display area, boasting an impressive array of over 15 distinct models. Each TV was meticulously labeled with its corresponding price tag, accompanied by comprehensive details and specifications.

Salesperson, Das, who guided me to the section where TVs were on display. As we began discussing my requirements, I specifically requested to see models from Sony, Samsung, and LG.

Das recommended Sony and Samsung as the top brands, with Sony being the superior choice due to its exceptional sound output and picture quality, which was 30% better than the competition. He also shared the technical specifications I had inquired about, such as the operating system, processor, and picture and sound quality.

For instance, he showed me a Sony 55-inch TV and a Samsung model as well. He mentioned that Sony was more affordable because it was now being manufactured in India.

Additionally, Das pointed out a TV that was particularly suitable for gaming, taking into consideration my interests.

The presentation gave a sense that the sales person had an understanding of the various brands and provided a sight of the differentiations.

The sales person  I spoke with was incredibly knowledgeable and addressed all of my inquiries regarding TV , finances , payment and exchanges 


Furthermore, since it was Republic Day, there were ongoing campaigns and attractive offers available.

When asked about the sales manager, he seemed at ease and introduced me to Shiv Kumar, the sales manager. I shared my requirements with him and insisted on getting discounts.

The price of Sony, originally 85990 rupees, was discounted to 77391 rupees. Similarly, Samsung , priced at 89990 rupees, was discounted to 80990 rupees with the assistance of the sales manager.

Delivery was promised within 2 days, and standard installation was included. However, any additional requirements or deviations would incur charges payable to the technician.

The availability of the product would be confirmed by the manager, and if the stock is not available, we can expect shipment within 7 to 10 days.

It is important to note that prices in other stores may vary, either higher or lower. The competition is fierce, and there are some shops that may offer lower prices. The sales manager did not seem very confident about the pricing he was offering.

To start with, he offered a 12% discount, but he mentioned that he would consult with the internal management if further discounts were needed.

After carefully collecting my information, he efficiently registered it and handed me both a hard copy and a digital version of the bills.
He then proceeded to provide a comprehensive overview of all the finance options at my disposal, ensuring I had a clear understanding of each one.

Delving into the topic further, he elaborated on the benefits and features of financial services such as Bajaj Finances, HDFC credit cards ,ICICI Bank , IDFC  etc… 

While he mentioned the possibility of a no-cost EMI/Cash back , he clarified that it could only be availed through a single swipe and was not applicable for multiple transactions.

The individual was uncertain about bulk finance and wanted to confirm and authenticate it.
He discussed the possibility of exchanging the old TV and provided me with an idea of the concessions I could receive. However, the quality of the TV would determine the extent of these concessions.
He explained the distinction between full swipe and EMI credit card payments, emphasizing that EMI is always the preferable option.

The Republic Day offer is still applicable for the next four days, and you will be able to avail of it since we have generated the quotation today.

In the quotation, he mentioned the current prices. He informed me that the sales manager would be sending the discounted price to my email, which I am still waiting for.

He played the content on YouTube and Samsung, showcasing the quality difference between both TVs. The quality of the TV was excellent in terms of buyer experience, providing a lot of confidence and clarity.

The salesperson demonstrated a commendable level of knowledge. The overall quality of the establishment, its workers, and the team was good. 

The mystery shopping visit uncovered a positive customer experience at Croma , Koramangala    .The staff demonstrated professionalism, and the sales process was customer-centric, thereby contributing to a favourable impression.


Conclusion:
Based on the results of the mystery shopping audit, it is evident that Croma , Koramangala    is currently providing a commendable customer experience. However, there are still areas where improvements can be made to enhance service quality and maintain positive interactions with potential customers.

Areas for Improvement:
1. Encourage staff to proactively discuss financing options and address potential customer concerns. By doing so, we can ensure that potential buyers feel well-informed and confident in their decision-making process.

2. Ensure consistent adherence to the follow-up procedures outlined as was expecting to have the bill by this time which has not yet come .
4. The team needs to have confidence in the pricing strategy and understand the advantages of buying from this particular shop compared to others, which have not been discussed. It is crucial for the team to be aware of the unique selling points that set us apart from our competitors as shop . 

By implementing these recommendations, we can further elevate our customer service standards and create an even more satisfying experience for our valued customers.

In conclusion, while BMW Gallops Autohaus displayed commendable responsiveness and basic service delivery, there are clear opportunities for enhancement. Recommendations include refining rapport-building techniques to foster a more personalised customer experience, intensifying efforts to understand and address customer needs, and providing thorough explanations of available finance options to facilitate informed decision-making. report_summary:
Date: 22/02/2024
Introduction:
The audit conducted at TimeZone Entertainment & Recreation aimed to assess various aspects of the establishment's operations, customer service, and facilities. The following report summarizes the observations and findings during the audit process.
Observations and Findings:
Upon arrival at TimeZone Entertainment & Recreation, situated in Ambience Mall - Gurgaon, meticulous attention was paid to every detail of the premises. Disguised as a college student, I entered the venue at 2:35 pm and commenced the audit by engaging with the staff and exploring the gaming floor.
Customer Service Excellence:
The demeanor of the staff members was commendable, exhibiting professionalism and courtesy throughout the interaction. Queries regarding pricing options were diligently addressed, albeit discrepancies were noted regarding the minimum amount for game cards.
Facilities and Equipment:
A thorough assessment of the gaming machines revealed a predominantly functional array of equipment. However, it was observed that a few machines, including Hyper Nova, Pirate Captain, Asphalt 9 Legends, and certain arcade machines, were temporarily non-operational. Nonetheless, the cleanliness and maintenance of the premises were impeccable, with the diligent efforts of the cleaning staff ensuring a pristine environment.
Engagement and Activities:
Active participation in various games and experiences provided invaluable insights into the customer experience. From exhilarating rounds of Cricket to immersive VR adventures, each activity contributed to an enriching audit experience. Notably, interactions with staff members facilitated an understanding of customer engagement strategies and service standards.
Operational Efficiency:
While the operational efficiency of the establishment was commendable, certain areas for improvement were identified. The absence of a second cash counter resulted in queues, inconveniencing patrons during peak hours. Furthermore, the accessibility of the prize redemption counter raised concerns regarding customer satisfaction and adherence to audit requirements.
Conclusion:
In conclusion, TimeZone Entertainment & Recreation presents a captivating destination for leisure and entertainment. The vibrant atmosphere, coupled with an array of engaging activities, promises an enjoyable experience for visitors. Despite minor operational challenges, the overall impression remains favorable, warranting a return visit for further exploration and enjoyment.
Recommendations:
Enhance operational efficiency by implementing additional cash counters during peak hours.
Prioritize accessibility and functionality of prize redemption counters to enhance customer satisfaction.
Consider implementing security measures to ensure the safety and well-being of patrons.
Acknowledgments:
This report serves to provide valuable insights for the continuous improvement and optimization of services at TimeZone Entertainment & Recreation.
