report_summary:
Timezone was located in the mall near the food court, making it easily accessible and visible to the constant flow of people passing by. The signage was large and easily visible from a distance, making it simple to locate.
As I entered the center, I was immediately struck by how clean and well-maintained it was. The lights were bright, illuminating the space and creating a welcoming atmosphere. There was no sign of any litter or debris on the floor, and the dustbins were visible and easily accessible. The Fun Squad members maintained a professional appearance at all times. Female members had their hair properly pinned up and styled in a bun. Male members were clean-shaven with neatly trimmed hair and also had uniforms that were in good condition. All members wore clean white sports shoes that are white. This attention to detail that the Fun Squad presented a polished and cohesive image. During my visit to Fun Squad, Lokesh greeted me with a smile and made eye contact as I approached the cash counter. He asked for my name and mobile number while processing my card purchase. Lokesh also informed me about the available offers, particularly the Gold card benefits, when I inquired about booking a birthday party. The Gold card allowed me to save money by loading it with 1000 rupees and receiving 12500 rupees in return, which was a great offer. Fun Squad was able to answer all of my questions about the current offers and even presented me with options for premium and classic party packages. The team member handed me the card with both hands, showing a high level of professionalism. I was also introduced to the Timezone Fun App, which added to my overall experience. The staff at Fun Squad were attentive and eager to assist with any queries I had. The waiting time at the cash counter was minimal, and I was able to speak with a team member within a couple of minutes. Both billing counters were operational during my visit, and the LCDs on top of the cash counters were in working condition. I noticed one team member wearing a yellow Fun Squad T-shirt, which added to the vibrant atmosphere of the center. The temperature inside the center was comfortable, adding to the overall pleasant experience. All the games I played were in perfect working order and well-maintained by the staff. I made my payment via UPI transaction, which was completed successfully. I redeemed a candy stick and a 5-star 3D chocolate from the merchandise center using the points I had collected, and Lokesh provided me with a receipt for my redemption. I was pleased to discover that there was a Birthday Party Room available at the center. Upon inspection, I found that the room was well-maintained, with furniture properly aligned and the space free of clutter. The communication about Birthday Party packages was clear, with a large signboard at the entrance providing information. Lokesh, a staff member, explained the Birthday Party packages to me, detailing the current offers and presenting options for premium and classic party packages. His presentation was informative and helpful. Throughout the center, staff members were strategically located at key locations such as Bowling, Bumper Car, Carnival, Camel Racer, VR, Prize Shop, and other rides. The Prize Shop/Slat Wall is meticulously maintained, ensuring it is always tidy, organized, and fully stocked. Clear ticket values are prominently displayed for each item on the Prize Wall. Additionally, a designated seating area is provided in the center for guests' convenience. The games are thoughtfully arranged in proper order for easy access and enjoyment. As I was departing, a member of the Fun Squad graciously thanked me for visiting the establishment.
Overall Impressions:
The overall atmosphere of the amusement center was lively and inviting, with a diverse range of attractions suitable for various age groups.
The experience was enjoyable, and I would likely recommend the amusement center to friends and family.
Recommendations:
Provide additional training to staff members on upselling techniques and product knowledge to enhance the guest experience.
I did not come across any hand sanitizers during my visit. It is possible that they were available but not easily visible. Perhaps they should be placed in more prominent locations for easy access.
The sound decibel level remained mostly within the defined threshold, but further investigation is needed to determine why it exceeded 85 decibels at times.

Afzal followed up with a message on WhatsApp to confirm the booking.

During our conversation, he did not mentioned the purchase and financing option, which is understandable. However, he emphasized the importance of visiting the store to make an informed decision.

Although the sign board from the main road was not clearly visible, once you got to the alley near the shop, the signage was clear. Upon entering the store, the interior was clean and inviting. On this particular day, it was warmer than usual, yet still acceptable. I did not observe any broken or damaged articles, tiles, or floors inside the store. More fans would have been nice . 

I met Abhinandan , the customer service person at the shop, where he immediately engaged me in conversation. He was groomed, with his hair neatly combed and dressed in the BeepKart branded polo T-shirt. Abhinandan took the time to understand my needs and presented me with a variety of options available in the store. He provided me with details on the cost, year of manufacture, and even arranged a test drive for me promptly.
During our conversation, Abhinandan highlighted the unique features of BeepKart vehicles and explained why they were the best choice for me. He discussed warranty options, vehicle quality, financing possibilities, and how BeepKart stood out from its competitors. Abhinandan also inquired about my budget and ensured that all my questions were answered thoroughly by the knowledgeable staff.
To make my experience even more enjoyable, Abhinandan and his team offered my family and me a comfortable place to sit and even provided us with refreshing juice to combat the hot weather. We felt truly welcomed and well taken care of throughout our time at the store.

The test drive experience was excellent, with the vehicle being clean and in good condition. Although the staff did not follow up on my experience after the test drive, I believe this was acceptable as the vehicle was relatively new and I did not encounter any issues.

Specifically, they mentioned IDFC . According to the staff, IDFC is apparently the only bank that allows financing for second-hand scooters and bikes. While a proper quotation with automated details would have been helpful, the staff did provide me with information on the required documents for the final deal. Although there was no big discount for the vehicle I chose, the staff explained the available offers and discount schemes on their website. He was  able to answer all my queries related to pricing and financing.

Visit to Timezone, R-City Ghatkopar (April 13, 2024)
Overall Experience: Good

Positives:

Clean and well-maintained facility.
Most games were operational.
Staff was helpful when asked for assistance with games.
Birthday package information was clearly explained and a brochure was provided.
Areas for Improvement:

Staff could be more proactive in greeting customers and informing them about offers.
Several games (5-6) were not working during the visit.
High noise levels (above 82 dB) could be bothersome for some visitors.
Limited staff presence on the floor (more staff observed at cash counters).
Ticket collected reader machine was not there to know how much tickets I had won and had to ask at the cash counter for that.
Difficulty redeeming tickets:
Merchandise prices didn't always match ticket denominations, making it hard to redeem for desired items.
Many items were out of stock were less stocked and there were a few empty places and boxes.
Unused credit on game card: The minimum recharge amount forced selection of a card with more credit than needed. Oddly priced games resulted in leftover credit unusable for any games.
Recommendations:

Train staff to greet customers and offer information about promotions.
Address malfunctioning games promptly.
Implement noise reduction strategies if possible.
Increase staff presence on the floor to provide better assistance to customers.
Improve ticket reader functionality and ensure merchandise pricing aligns with ticket values.
Maintain adequate stock of popular redemption items.
Consider offering games suitable for leftover credit or allowing players to top up with smaller denominations.
Additional Notes:

The visit was during peak hours on a Saturday, which likely contributed to the high noise level and large crowds.
Overall, despite some shortcomings, the experience was enjoyable. However, improvements in staff engagement, game maintenance, ticket redemption system, and credit utilization options would further enhance customer satisfaction.

REPORT

Title: Mystery Shopping Evaluation of Porsche Service Centre Kochi, Maradu Kundannoor Branch

Date: 23rd April 2023

Introduction:
On the 23rd of April 2023, a mystery shopping call was conducted to assess the customer service experience at the Porsche Service Centre in Kochi, specifically the Maradu Kundannoor branch. The objective was to evaluate the responsiveness, professionalism, and effectiveness of the service center staff in handling customer inquiries and issues.

Call Details:
The call was answered by Mr. Kurian, who identified the Porsche Service Centre Kochi in his greeting. However, it was observed that Mr. Kurian did not reciprocate the caller's greeting. The caller proceeded to describe a scenario regarding an issue with the gear transmission of their car, expressing concerns about the shifting feeling heavy. The caller inquired about the next steps and whether an appointment needed to be scheduled.

Observations and Findings:
1. Lack of Reciprocal Greeting: Mr. Kurian did not greet the caller in return, which may indicate a lack of courtesy and attentiveness to customer engagement. A warm and welcoming greeting is crucial in establishing a positive rapport with customers.

2. Professional Handling of Inquiry: Mr. Kurian demonstrated professionalism by asking for more details about the issue with the caller's car. He actively listened to the caller's explanation and sought relevant information to assist further.

3. Assistance in Scheduling Service: Mr. Kurian suggested that the caller tow their car to the service center for inspection and repair. He also requested the caller's name and car model for documentation purposes. However, it was noted that the caller did not have the registration number or chassis number readily available.

4. Assurance of Follow-Up: Mr. Kurian assured the caller that someone from customer service would contact them to gather additional details and guide them through the process of bringing the car to the service center.

Closure of Audit:
Despite Mr. Kurian's assurance of follow-up, it was reported that the caller did not receive any calls, SMS, or WhatsApp messages from the service center within 24 hours. As confirmed by FloorWalk, the audit was closed as of 24th April at 14:05 PM.

Politely, they asked Mr. Mahipal about WiFi availability for transactions, but were promptly advised to use an alternative payment method such as cash or card. After settling the bill with cash, the shopper explored the venue, noticing that several games, including Transformers, were out of order. Despite this, they engaged in a few games before proceeding to inquire about booking a party. Seeing someone mopping the floor, the shopper sought assistance for their birthday party inquiry. Ms. Rani promptly responded and escorted them to a separate room, where she explained the available party areas and the minimum booking requirement of 10 children. She detailed two pricing plans, Rs. 2250 and Rs. 1750 per head respectively, and offered the shopper the option to take photographs if desired. Upon request, Ms. Rani provided bottled water and requested that the shopper confirm their decision directly with her, sharing her contact information for convenience. With the inquiry concluded, the shopper bid farewell and left Timezone.

Peer or influencer recommendations are considerably influential in their decision-making process.
Durability and longevity of beginner's bras have a medium impact on their purchasing decisions.

Distribution channels include e-commerce, offline retail, and online retail platforms like AJIO.

Beginner's bra brands can better cater to the needs of pre-teens and teenagers through inclusive sizing, comfort-focused designs, inclusive marketing, and engagement.

Packaging adds value to the overall purchasing experience and influences brand recognition and recommendations.

Improvements in fitting rooms are suggested to enhance the overall shopping experience.
Additional services like bra fitting consultations and alterations are considered very important.
Both online and in-store shopping offer unique advantages in terms of convenience and shopping experience.

report_summary:
INTRODUCTION:-
This audit report provides a detailed account of observations and experiences during a visit to Timezone Entertainment Center, covering various aspects from entry to exit. The audit aimed to evaluate customer service, game functionality, staff knowledge, party arrangements, and overall visitor satisfaction. 
ENTRY EXPERIENCE:- 
Upon arrival at Timezone, there was no Fun Squad present at the entrance to greet or assist visitors. This lack of initial engagement left an unfavorable impression and hindered the start of the customer experience.
CUSTOMER SERVICE AND PAYMENT PROCESS:- 
At the payment counter, the cashier demonstrated rudeness and a lack of transparency in payment procedures. Direct demands for payment of a fixed amount without providing details of available offers or the number of games playable at that rate were noted. Additionally, visitors reported difficulty in getting assistance when games malfunctioned, leading to financial losses and dissatisfaction. 
GAME EXPERIENCE:- 
Numerous issues were observed with game functionality, including a car game where 2 cars were out of order. This negatively impacted the overall gaming experience, especially for families seeking quality time together. Furthermore, conflicts arose among visitors, particularly regarding the cricket game, due to perceived favoritism by staff members and extended wait times for other players. 
PARTY ARRANGEMENTS:- 
During the inquiry of birthday party arrangements, only one Fun Squad appeared knowledgeable about the process, resulting in delays and inconvenience for visitors. Additionally, suggestions to order food from Pizza Hut raised concerns regarding potential promotional activities or undisclosed affiliations. 
CUSTOMER SERVICE RESPONSE:- 
Despite complaints and requests for intervention from upset parents, the response from supervisors was lacking. Supervisor involvement did not result in immediate resolution or mitigation of issues, indicating a gap in addressing customer concerns effectively. 
EXIT EXPERIENCE:-
As visitors exited Timezone, there was no staff present to bid farewell or inquire about their experience, concluding the visit on a disappointing note.
CONCLUSION:-
In conclusion, the audit revealed significant deficiencies in customer service, game functionality, staff knowledge, party arrangements, and conflict resolution at Timezone Entertainment Center. Addressing these issues is crucial to enhancing visitor satisfaction and maintaining the center's reputation as a premier entertainment destination.
RECOMMENDATIONS:-
Provide comprehensive staff training to ensure consistent and knowledgeable customer service. Implement transparent pricing policies and improve communication regarding available offers and game functionality. Enhance game maintenance procedures to minimize downtime and maximize visitor enjoyment. Review party planning processes to streamline arrangements and improve customer experience. Establish clear protocols for conflict resolution and empower supervisors to address customer concerns promptly.
MANAGEMENT RESPONSE:-
Timezone management is urged to review the findings outlined in this audit report and take proactive measures to address identified shortcomings. Swift action is necessary to uphold the center's reputation and prioritize customer satisfaction.

report_summary: I made a call at the Tattva YooPune location to book an appointment for a Swedish massage for 60 minutes. The call was made on 15/05/2024 to book and appointment for 16/05/2024 at 04:30 PM. The call was answered by Mr. Mahesh Wagh who did not introduce himself with the name of Spa, it's location or with his own name. Upon asking for the services cost of Swedish massage, the call representative was able to answer accurately and also told me that they have an on-going offer between Monday to Thursday where they are providing a total of 90 minutes massage at the cost of 60 minutes. I asked him about the massages available and the difference in them. He was able to answer my queries properly and was polite. After booking the appointment, I visited the spa at the given address and location. The place had a very good ambiance and the Spa was in a society premises which was beautiful covered with lush green garden. The brand elements available at the outlet were well-maintained. Upon entering the spa, the entrance was welcoming with a serene environment and I was welcomed with a welcome drink. The Spa representative showed me the options of different oils and was able to differentiate in them upon asking which demonstrated that she was quite able to handle the before therapy scenario. She also showed me the smells of the oils but did not explain to me about the therapies like how I will be feeling after the massage and what are the expected benefits of them. I was also not explained about the membership offers or the spa gift cards. She did not took into consideration the specific health points or conveyed to the therapist but introduced me to her. After an initial process, the therapy started well within time and was completed within 60 minutes. However, no body mentioned about the offer that was conveyed to me on call regarding the surplus 90 minutes massage. After some time of the therapy, I asked the therapist if the door is locked, she said that it is locked and she has put a bag of worries outside the door. Considering the entire therapy room and its upkeep including the washroom area with all appliances, it was well-maintained and hygienic and there were no hazards found. After completing the therapy, I was asked for mode of payment to which I told that it would be through a gift card and after some time I pretended that I was not able to find it. The receptionist suggested me to have a seat and search the card as she needed to click a photo and send it for approval to redeem. When I asked her if there are any chances to search from their system, she denied. After some time, the voucher was shown and was easily redeemed then but I had to ask for a bill which was then provided. At the end while I was leaving, I was not thanked for my visit but the spa representative was waiting outside with umbrella as it was raining and she offered me accompanying her in the umbrella to protect from rains which was a good gesture. Despite these minor issues, I enjoyed my time at Timezone. The games were fun and engaging, and the opportunity to win interesting prizes added to the excitement. Enhancing staff proactivity and ensuring the air conditioning is consistently effective would further improve the overall experience.

On June 1st, I called customer care and was attended by Afzal, who provided comprehensive information on the location and available bikes. He encouraged me to visit the outlet for a test drive and explained the payment options, following up with a WhatsApp message for further communication. I visited the outlet on June 2nd in the evening. Upon arrival, I contacted Afzal, who directed me to Suhana. Suhana inquired about my bike preferences and purpose, suggesting the Apache for a 200cc option. When I expressed interest in higher cc models, she mentioned the Interceptor and introduced me to her colleague, Abhinandan.

Abhinandan showed me the well-maintained Interceptor, provided detailed information, and offered a test drive, which I accepted. He explained the price, ₹2.83 lakh, and the purchasing process. For cash payments, the bike could be handed over in one hour; for financing, it would take 24 to 48 hours. The financing required a 30 to 35% down payment and an online eligibility application, handled by the IDFC team. When I inquired about interest rates and potential discounts, Abhinandan stated that the interest rate was 13% and non-negotiable, with no flexibility on the price or down payment.

The outlet experience was marred by poor lighting and a shabby environment, with concrete flooring, oil leaks, and an overall dull atmosphere that felt like a basement parking area. The store appeared understaffed, with some employees idling outside. The exterior was dirty, shared with a Tata service center. Despite these issues, the overall experience was good, but the ambiance of the outlet left much to be desired. I did not receive any follow-up calls and plan to inform the team once I get one.

report_summary: When I arrived at the showroom, a receptionist greeted me first. I mentioned that I was interested in the Q5, and she asked me to take a seat. I noticed that the Q5 was prominently displayed near the entrance. Shortly after, a sales staff member approached me, took my contact details, and sent me his visiting card via WhatsApp. He offered me tea, coffee, and some cookies. Once I informed him of my interest in purchasing a Q5 Audi, he began verbally explaining its features without any multimedia aid or showing me the car. He emphasized that the Q5 has a 265 horsepower engine, a 2-litre capacity, and a 4x4 Quattro wheel drive system. He compared it to the Mercedes GLC, which focuses more on aesthetics, and the BMW, which is more focused on fittings, stating that Audi prioritizes drive, torque, and power. He then showed me the displayed vehicle, highlighting the sunroof and interior legroom. He mentioned that delivery of grey and blue models would be within 4 days upon receiving a booking amount of Rs 3 lakhs, with a corporate discount and an MNC discount of Rs 35,000 available only once. For other colors, delivery would take 7 to 10 days. He inquired about when I planned to pick up the car, and I mentioned August. He suggested the option to buy during Rath Yatra in July, an auspicious occasion. He also mentioned there was no buy-back option but suggested Audi Plus. He informed me that there was no in-house financing available, but I could obtain financing from any nationalized bank at an interest rate of 8.5% to 8.9% based on my documents. He offered a test drive, despite the car being a bit muddy. During the test drive, he focused mostly on torque and pickup, demonstrating the music system with 19 speakers. He reiterated that Audi's focus is on driving experience rather than gadgets or special aesthetics. He stated that the dimensions of all three manufacturers in the range were similar. He promised to share price quotations, EMI options, insurance, and service pack details, but I did not receive them within 24 hours. Overall, he was well-groomed, and polite, and offered an at-home test drive. He also offered an evaluation of my existing Mahindra Thar and assured me of the best possible discounts.

Issues: The Lucky Gold and Ticket Dome games were not operational at the time of the visit. Evidence of these issues is attached.

Pricing:

Minimum Card Value: The minimum card value available for purchase is ₹1500, contrary to the previously understood amount of ₹600. Consequently, reimbursement should be adjusted to ₹1500.

Maintenance: Immediate action is needed to ensure all games, including the Lucky Gold and Ticket Dome, are consistently operational.

Crowd Management: Deploying additional Fun Squad members during weekends will enhance visitor experience and safety.

Pricing Clarity: Clear communication regarding the minimum card value of ₹1500 is essential to avoid misunderstandings and ensure customer satisfaction.

Birthday Packages: While the birthday packages offer substantial entertainment options, the lack of a dedicated birthday hall at Orion Mall limits the celebration experience. Coordination with nearby venues like Mantri Mall, where such facilities are available, can provide a more comprehensive solution for birthday parties.

Overall, with these improvements, Time Zone at Orion Mall can significantly enhance its service quality and customer satisfaction.

After I gave my details, she seemed slightly shocked that I was there for my massage. She went through her laptop and said that the listed time was 4.30PM. I told her that I had called the previous day and spoke to her in the afternoon time. She had given me a confirmed appointment for 11.30AM. She agreed and mentioned that it could be that her CRE had messed up the timing slots. She apologized multiple times and requested me for just 10 minutes of waiting time. I agreed as it was only 10 minutes. But thereafter she received a couple who also had missed their appointment. She managed them smoothly and told me that it was their fault as their appointment was on the previous day ( which seemed genuine ). Then she seemed quite disturbed and received various calls which seemed to be of a personal nature. She left the reception for about 20minutes and returned. By which time, I was restless as I had waited for a long time. She rushed into the therapy room and spoke with the therapist. She then told me that I could come in. As I was entering the spa area, she started explaining the oils in brief. I listened to her and decided to go with the standard oil that they used. 

She introduced me to Abhi, the female therapist. She also greeted me. They both seemed to want to start the therapy as soon as possible as it was already delayed. She told me to wear the disposable underwear, keep my belongings on the table and clothes on the hooks. She then left and came back in after few minutes to start the therapy. She started with the foot cleansing which took about 3 minutes only. Then she checked if I was comfortable with the temperature and music levels. I asked if head massage was included and she said that she could add it at the end for 5minutes. I agreed. Therapy started with a dry massage and then she started using oils on each part of the body. It was a lovely massage as she had great skills. She was giving me higher pressure and I asked her to lower it slightly. She had great technique and mastery of massage skills. The whole massage went on comfortably and when it was time to turn over, I was felt cold. I requested Abhi to increase the temperature. She went out to get the remote and changed the temperature to 30 degrees centigrade. She completed the rest of the massage and told me that I could take a steam and shower. She gave me a towel to wear.

I then proceeded to the shower and bath area, guided by Abhi. She showed me the shower area and the towels. Then she asked me to take a seat in the steam room. I used it only for 2 minutes and proceeded to take my shower. The shower area was totally clean and had all the required toiletries. I enjoyed the nice hot shower and exited. 

When I reached the reception guided by Abhi, there was Lee present there. I was offered tea and I also wanted water. I was served both very quickly. I finished the payment formalities using the voucher. I asked her about the cash payment scenario and she flatly refused any discounts even if paid by cash. I then exited the spa at 1.56PM in the afternoon. It was a long visit to this Tatva Spa.

I visited the Play n Learn in Marina Mall on June 9, 2024, with my child. Upon entry, I noticed there was no crowd. When purchasing the ticket, I asked about the price, and the staff inquired about the number of children and adults. She informed me that the cost was Rs. 700. While she explained the packages, I chose the Rs. 700 option. She also asked if we needed socks, which were Rs. 40 for adults and free for children. I opted to pay via UPI, and she asked for Rs. 740, checked the system, and then handed over the bill and socks.

The adult socks were tight and seemed small. When I asked about this, she said it was a common issue and assured me they would fit, but they were very tight and of poor quality. She asked us to leave our shoes and slippers in a locker, but when I inquired about the key, she said they don't provide one. We had to find an available locker ourselves without assistance.

At the entrance, we were given wristbands. Inside the play area, the temperature was not well-regulated, and it seemed the air conditioning was off. They had turned off the projector and ball vacuum motor due to the lack of a crowd and didn't play any music. When I requested the projector be turned on, they obliged.

There were no staff members, or fun buddies, present to help the children. I noticed broken toys in the seeds area and damaged sponges at the corners. The role-play area was messy and poorly organized. When I inquired about hosting a birthday party, I was told that only the manager could provide details, but she wouldn't be available for another half hour.

Some play areas were not functioning well, and the wall clock was ten minutes fast. When leaving, I finally saw the manager in a blue coat. She confirmed that the charges hadn't changed, showed me the brochure, and took down the date for the birthday party, explaining the details. However, there was no farewell, and none of the staff wore name tags.
